newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee moves higher in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee moves higher in late trade.

text.p: LIFFE Robusta coffee futures moved higher in the final stages of trade after New York coffee rose sharply.
Local and light speculative buying bolstered New York in choppy dealings, floor sources said.
On LIFFE, September last traded $42 higher at $1,660.
Earlier, LIFFE futures had maintained a weak stance throughout most of Monday's session, staying reluctant to stray too far from the recent tight trading ranges.
In early trade, light trade selling pressured the benchmark September contract down to an intraday low of $1,585 but the lower prices quickly attracted bargain-hunters from among the speculators.
Traders said spread dealings had accounted for a significant part of the day's turnover of 2,609 lots, with Sept/Nov amd Sept/Jan attracting the most interest.
September has traded very tight ranges for the last week as it has drifted down towards the $1,600 mark.
Technical analysts said the September contract was likely to do more support-building ahead of any attack on strong resistance at $1,700.
Fundamental news was scarce although independent meteorologist Somar said a cold front was forecast to enter Brazil's coffee producing areas this week.
But cloud cover will prevent frosts in the coffee belt and minimum temperatures were forecast at between eight and 10 degrees Celsius, it said.
